items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 11 at 11:02PM EDT until October 12 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding during high tide.

* WHERE...Coastal Collier County, Mainland Monroe, and Far South
Miami-Dade County.

* WHEN...Through Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
